Each attacker's own template, check and draft DAT download answer 200; check changes nothing; the download adds exactly one source-provenance audit receipt and its bytes, hash and source digest agree. For every action a foreign organization is refused 403, the victim's legal-employer selector 404, and a foreign employee reference 422 (check and download); no response mentions the victim's marker, employee or TIN. For every action an anonymous caller is refused 401, a cross-site mutation 403 and a malformed body 400; a stale digest is 409 and an unknown action 400. The victim's and both attackers' complete snapshots (workers, runs, entries, year-end rows, remittances, audit) stay byte-identical. Not proven: concurrent requests, an official BIR module validation, or production data.
